settings.question: Will it work with my TV?
settings.answer: TV consoles connect over HDMI. Check that your TV or monitor has a free HDMI port.

settings.question: Do I need internet to play?
settings.answer: To be confirmed per model. Edit this answer once verified.

settings.question: How do I track my order?
settings.answer: Use the link in your dispatch email, or see the Order Tracking page.

settings.question: How do I report a damaged or defective product?
settings.answer: Use the Contact page and choose 'Report a damaged or defective product'. Include your order number.
